name: check_spawn_error_shape
description: Measures how Node's child_process reports an exec failure: synchronous throw vs async 'error' event vs spawnSync {error}, with the error code. Used to verify claims about which errnos (EPERM vs ENOENT etc.) throw synchronously from spawn/execFile/execFileSync — e.g. when auditing a sandbox-exec-deny emulation.

file.description: absolute path of the program to execute

waitMs.description: how long to wait for an async 'error' event before concluding it never comes (default 500)
